messages:
zara: Quick q  are we comfortable moving to one canonical draft API for console + runtime? Current split causes surprise rollouts.
dan: strongly yes.
lee: agree. propose: draft -> shadow-validate -> staged-promote -> global-promote. APIs: POST /configs/:id/drafts, POST /drafts/:id/validate, POST /drafts/:id/promote.
ops-bot: note  canary-runner needs draft_id + sample_rate params for shadow runs.
zara: UX needs to show estimated QPS, token cost, and a diff view (shadow vs baseline).
dan: safety: add thresholds (error_rate, p95) and auto-revert webhook when breached.
lee: pick cohort semantics: hash(user_id) by default; include cohort_key in draft.
zara: action items: lee write mini RFC + schema (Tue), dan prototype shadow telemetry namespacing (Thu).
